Continuation of AW9U's quarterly cadence. The 4Q2025 tranche (0.52 cents, 1 Oct-31 Dec 2025) is declared as a subsequent event on 5 Feb 2026 -- accrual, in respect of FY2025. 0.58+0.55+0.52+0.52=2.17 exactly matches headline DPU.
